scope: Read-only current/frozen predicate audit after independent grades sealed. No candidate edits, provider requests, browser operation or private draft inspection.

concreteCodePointers.finding: answerText aggregates answerText/conclusion/explanation/supported-point headings and explanations plus evidenceLimitations into one narrative.

nonZoningAnswerScope rejects the entire Construction/Fire scope if any non-null questionPlan, explicit zoning cue in current question OR aggregated narrative, or broad categorical project-approval expression occurs.

The actual binding exemption requires every bound evidence source to be eligible Construction/Fire authority; contextual/irrelevant roles, contextualReference, referenceOnly and section_reference records deny it.
Generic pronouns such as this/it count as project heads. Regulatory predicates include compliant/allowed/prohibited and broad is...required/subject-to forms.
Any discovered ZR source opens zoning riskProfile unless nonZoningAnswerScope succeeds; presence is broader than an active zoning conclusion.

When zoning profile is active, any generic categoricalProjectConclusion in aggregated narrative with no cited ZR source raises zoning_unbound_conclusion, even if that conclusion is bound to a technical BC rule.

General answer branch evaluates zoning safety before ordinary provider verification; rejection triggers bounded revision/deterministic recheck. Observed two deterministic failures are consistent with this path but do not reveal exact rejected private narrative.

genericReadOnlyReproduction.method: Import pure evaluateZoningResearchSafety. Use complete frozen BC912.4.2 body with eligible governing B1 binding, one synthetic unrelated ZR record, and a narrowly scoped technical front-clearance conclusion. Toggle one scope feature per case; no providers or implementation fixtures modified.
genericReadOnlyReproduction.confirmedDefect: Adding only a harmless negative zoning evidence limitation to an otherwise eligible BC-bound technical conclusion changes applies:false/pass to applies:true/zoning_unbound_conclusion. The limiter is treated as an active zoning cue and generic this...not compliant technical language as a Zoning conclusion.
genericReadOnlyReproduction.intentionalGuardCases: Reference-only/contextual source flags and broad whole-project approval also block exemption. Their production values are unknown and they must not be blanket-disabled.

actualCauseConfidence.verified: Deterministic gate rejected twice with zoning_unbound_conclusion; BC912.4.2 and unrelated ZR reference listed; no provider verification phase observed. Correct governing canonical text exists.
actualCauseConfidence.conditional: The benign zoning-limitation branch is a confirmed generic counterexample and plausible cause, not a proven explanation of this production draft. Non-null zoning plan, unsupported categorical project approval, bound source roles or reference-only flags can lead to the same issue.
unknown: Actual rejected draft narrative and supported-point text
Actual citation and supported-point source-ID bindings
Complete actual writer excerpt at the moment of rejection

boundedGeneralNextStep.principle: Evaluate active legal claims and their eligible authoritative bindings, rather than automatically broadening a BC/FC technical conclusion into zoning based on all narrative fields or unrelated retrieved sources.
boundedGeneralNextStep.safeBoundary: A negative evidence-limitations statement about unreviewed zoning should not itself create an operative zoning conclusion. Allow narrow construction/fire conclusions only with actual eligible complete canonical supporting bindings; still evaluate independent zoning clauses and categorical whole-project approval. Do not ignore invalid/ref-only bindings or grant approval because a BC citation exists.
preserve: Normal semantic verification after deterministic gates

diagnosticOnlyIfActualBranchUnavailable.proposal: Add typed structural scope-rejection enumeration to existing attempt diagnostics, no private prose/envelope.

limitations: Safe telemetry only; no raw private provider payload/draft or issue-detail prose inspected. Read-only synthetic predicate exercise establishes generic branch behavior, not the unknown production narrative. All candidate outcomes retain their original independent labels; no unseen valid draft credited.
